ChangeNotes.Value: v1.0.1 - Bugfixes from the first day's field reports: companions who fought on the opposing half (or scattered after a lost drill) now return with their party roles intact (scout, engineer, quartermaster, surgeon); no more 'Tracking: separated after a battle' popups in settlements for companions already riding with you (stale entries are cleaned from your save on load); the time-of-day picker now shows the live campaign clock and marks your pinned hour as 'your pick' so a standing pin is never mistaken for the current time.
